questions.question_english: When a school administrator calculates the mean score of a class on a standardized reading test, the data must be assumed to be at least at which level of measurement?
options_english: Interval
Nominal
Ordinal
Absolute
questions.explanation_english: Calculating parametric statistics such as the arithmetic mean requires data measured on at least an interval scale. Nominal and ordinal scales lack equal intervals, making the calculation of a true arithmetic mean statistically inappropriate.

questions.explanation_english: The nominal scale is the simplest level of measurement, functioning primarily to classify data into distinct, non-overlapping qualitative categories or labels. questions.explanation_english: The correct option is 'Primary definition and framework'. An improperly calibrated scale that consistently adds five marks to every score yields highly consistent results across testing attempts, demonstrating high reliability. However, because the scores are systematically inaccurate, the test fails to measure true achievement levels, rendering it invalid. Reliability requires score consistency, while validity demands measurement accuracy.

questions.question_english: 43. Sociometry, as a measurement tool introduced by J.L. Moreno, is primarily used in educational settings to:
options_english: Map social relationships, acceptance patterns, and peer isolation within a student group
Measure and classify the overall socioeconomic status and background of a student's family
Determine the specific cognitive development stage and intellectual reasoning level of children
Assess the formal oral and written linguistic proficiency of linguistic minority students
questions.explanation_english: Sociometry is an evaluative technique used to map, measure, and analyze interpersonal choices and social structures within a peer group. By gathering peer preferences, it reveals class dynamics, social acceptance, informal cliques, and peer isolation, helping educators design inclusive seating arrangements and foster positive social development in classrooms.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। सामाजिकता एक मूल्यांकन तकनीक है जिसका उपयोग सहपाठी समूह के भीतर अंतरव्यक्तिगत विकल्पों और सामाजिक संरचनाओं को मानचित्रित, मापने और विश्लेषण करने के लिए किया जाता है। सहपाठी प्राथमिकताओं को एकत्र करके, यह कक्षा की गतिशीलता, सामाजिक स्वीकृति, अनौपचारिक समूहों और साथियों के अलगाव को उजागर करता है, जिससे शिक्षकों को समावेशी बैठने की व्यवस्था बनाने और कक्षाओं में सकारात्मक सामाजिक विकास को बढ़ावा देने में मदद मिलती है।
